notablePrerequisites:
Ritual Chamber is locked.
Marina and Tidewater Minion do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Ritual Chamber.
Ritual Chamber triggers, creating a 6/6 Demon creature token with flying.
When the Demon enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Ritual Chamber.
Activate Tidewater Minion by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.
